title: Language and Silence
author: Paloma Reyes
blurb: Oscar Crane, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
